text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto proved herself with results on 
the track. In the Trainer's assessment, 
she ran a great race and is fully capable 
of handling the pace of Senior-tier graded 
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she gets fired up for the spring 
GⅠ, her best friend Matikanefukukitaru 
stands in her way. The stage for the GⅠ 
prep race is set at the Kinko Sho.
